concerns.text: All tasks T002‑T013 are marked with the `[P]` parallel‑safe tag, yet each of them explicitly consumes artifacts produced by earlier tasks (e.g., T002 reads the project layout from T001, T003 reads files generated by T002, T004 reads QC outputs from T003, etc.). This creates hidden ordering dependencies, meaning the tasks are **not** safe to run concurrently with other `[P]` tasks. The `[P]` tag should be removed or the tasks re‑structured to be truly side‑effect‑free before they can be considered parallel‑safe.
